title: Cameo PM Runbook
subtitle: Eversys Cameo | C'2c, C'2s, C'2ms (Classic, Core, ST, Cameo X) | preventive maintenance kits and steps
sources: Based on the Cameo | C'choco PM Kits Manual V4.0 (SAP 5700105620, 01.05.2026), TI-240, and the e'Support history of service kit releases V3.0 (12.10.2026). Check the Webshop configurator with the machine's serial number before ordering.

banners.text: Updated October 2026 to the Cameo PM Kits Manual V4.0: 24-month kits are now 36-month kits (TI-240). Old 24-month kits in stock can be used for the 36-month PM.
C'2c has no steam boiler: no steam or milk kits.
C'2s has no milk system, so milk-module and frame add-on kits are not listed.
12-month PM: only 12-month kits are listed. Hydraulic, steam 36, Everfoam, milk 36 and frame Standard are 36-month items.

items.text: Check ground-coffee total: change burrs after every 2000 kg.
Clean the grinder at every service.
Clean, then apply a thin layer of grease (JAX Pyro-plate FGN) to the threads of the upper burr support.
Fit kit EV108358.
Clean, then grease the shafts of the bottom arm and the top piston with JAX Pyro-plate FGN.
Turn the piston screen 1/4 turn to lock it on the piston head, then tighten the piston head to 8 N·m.
Check the piston screens for clogging. Clean or replace if needed.
Fit EV108304.
Fit EV102865 for C'choco.
Fit EV102865 for automatic hot cleaning.
Descale the boiler with Eversys descaler (PI-19) if needed. Boiler spare part, if it must be changed: 104357.
Fit EV108380 (and EV108311 at 36 months) and the steam add-ons listed in section 2.
Apply Loctite Permabond MM115 pure to the thread of the air injector when reassembling.
Descale the boiler with Eversys descaler (PI-19) if needed. Steam boiler spare part: 104361.
Fit EV108339.
Fit EV108340.
Change the milk pipes (every 12 months). 25 m blue 106186, green 106189.
Apply Loctite Permabond MM115 pure to the thread of the air injector when reassembling.
Fit EV108359.
Fit the frame add-on listed in section 2 (EV108351 or EV108364).
Cut hose 104719 to length (270 mm + 55 mm). Clean the 1.5-Step outlet, the fitting silicone pipe and the aerator.
Fit EV109706.
Record the service (date, interval, kits used). Old 24-month kits may be used for the 36-month interval.

reference.title: Interval rule
reference.text: Under 50,000 cycles a year per group head: 12-month PM in years 1 and 2, 36-month PM in year 3, then repeat. Over 50,000: the same 12, 12, 36 pattern every 50,000 cycles. At least one PM a year is mandatory.

reference.title: Identify the model from the serial
reference.text: First 8 digits of the serial (e'Support, List of machine serial numbers - North America). C'2c: 00998100 Classic, 01139400 Core, 01147000 ST. C'2s: 00998200 or 01831300 Classic, 01138900 Core, 01146900 ST, 01063900 Cameo X. C'2ms: 00998300 or 01833300 Classic, 01092600 Core, 01146800 ST, 01031100 Cameo X. The rating plate is behind the left bean hopper.
